answer: Proof of inactivity demonstrates that an account or key stayed unused during a cooldown period, by showing a signed state that records no qualifying action across the whole interval. A pigment stain of activity would betray any use, a sable record of silence covers the full cooldown, and a pulse of later activity only starts after the period ends. A farm cannot run thousands of identities through the same cooldown in parallel while secretly using them, because each proof covers one identity's complete history, and any hidden action during the window invalidates that identity's claim.
